title: Testing for Coordination Failures in Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.27368v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep parallel cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (CMARL)} trains multiple agents that all act at every time step to optimize a common objective. Like single-agent RL, CMARL can produce unsafe behaviors that violate implicit safety requirements not captured by the reward, and these behaviors are hard to explain. However, testing CMARL policies for safety has received less attention than the safety testing of single-agent RL policies. In this paper, we propose DisQ, a test case selection method that identifies failure-revealing states in value-based CMARL by exploiting a signal specific to trained Q-learning agents. The signal is the Q-value gap, an explainable metric that flags a state when the agents' estimates of the achievable return diverge by more than a calibrated threshold. translated_title: 合作式多智能体强化学习中的协调失败测试
translated_abstract: 深度并行合作式多智能体强化学习（CMARL）训练多个在每个时间步都采取行动的智能体，以优化一个共同目标。与单智能体强化学习一样，CMARL可能产生违反奖励未捕获的隐式安全要求的不安全行为，且这些行为难以解释。然而，与单智能体强化学习策略的安全测试相比，CMARL策略的安全测试受到的关注较少。在本文中，我们提出了DisQ，这是一种测试用例选择方法，通过利用训练后的Q-learning智能体特有的信号，在基于价值的CMARL中识别能揭示失败的状态。该信号是Q值差距（Q-value gap），这是一个可解释的指标，当各智能体对可实现回报的估计之间的偏差超过校准阈值时，该指标会标记相应状态。DisQ选择这些状态进行执行，并跳过没有差距的状态。我们在四个CMARL基准环境中的实验表明，在大多数情况下...
tldr: 提出了DisQ方法，利用Q值差距这一可解释信号从基于价值的合作式多智能体强化学习中筛选出能揭示协调失败的关键状态，以高效检测智能体间的不安全行为。
en_tdlr: DisQ is a test case selection method that identifies failure-revealing states in value-based cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning by exploiting the Q-value gap, an explainable signal of divergence among agents' return estimates.
